product_overview: IGreen NPK is a microbial consortium-based biofertilizer containing beneficial bacteria Bacillus polymyxa, Bacillus megaterium, and Bacillus mucilaginosus. It enhances nitrogen fixation, phosphorus solubilization, and potassium mobilization in soil. The formulation improves nutrient availability and uptake efficiency for better plant growth and yield. It also promotes root development and soil microbial activity. IGreen NPK is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) systems.
key_product_highlights: Enhances availability of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium
Improves nutrient uptake and use efficiency
Promotes balanced root and shoot development
Solubilizes phosphorus and mobilizes potassium effectively
Boosts soil microbial activity and soil health
Increases crop yield and overall productivity

mechanism_of_action.description: The microbial consortium colonizes the rhizosphere and root surface, fixes atmospheric nitrogen through associative N-fixing members, solubilizes bound phosphorus and mobilizes native potassium pools, and drives microbial nutrient cycling in the soil. This combined activity improves nutrient availability, root uptake efficiency, and overall crop nutrition.

product_overview: IGreen SHIELD is a biological plant protection product formulated with a consortium of beneficial bacteria, including Bacillus licheniformis, Bacillus amyloliquefaciens, and Bacillus subtilis. It acts through antagonism, competitive colonization, and production of antimicrobial compounds to suppress a wide range of soil-borne and foliar pathogens. The formulation helps manage diseases such as Fusarium, Rhizoctonia, Alternaria, and powdery mildew. It also enhances root health, plant vigor, and natural defense mechanisms.
key_product_highlights: Controls bacterial diseases such as leaf blight with efficient biocontrol activity.
Produces antifungal compounds that disrupt pathogen growth and colonization.
Enhances systemic resistance in plants, providing long-lasting internal protection.
Improves overall plant health leading to increased yields and better crop quality.
Provides both preventive and curative effects for holistic crop protection.

mechanism_of_action.description: The consortium colonizes the rhizosphere, contributes associative nitrogen fixation, solubilizes native and applied nutrient pools, and sustains microbial nutrient cycling around feeder roots. By maintaining an active microbial zone near roots, it improves nutrient capture efficiency and stabilizes crop nutrition under stress-prone soil conditions.

product_overview: IGreen N is a single-nutrient biofertilizer based on the beneficial bacterium Azotobacter chroococcum, formulated for targeted nitrogen management. It fixes atmospheric nitrogen and makes it available to the plant, reducing dependence on synthetic urea and boosting vegetative growth. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) systems.
key_product_highlights: Delivers targeted nitrogen nutrition through biological atmospheric nitrogen fixation
Improves nutrient uptake efficiency and crop response
Reduces dependence on synthetic fertilizers
Enhances root development and rhizosphere activity
Compatible with organic farming and INM programs
Improves crop yield and produce quality

mechanism_of_action.description: Azotobacter chroococcum colonizes the rhizosphere and non-symbiotically fixes atmospheric N2 into plant-available ammonia through nitrogenase enzyme activity. It also secretes plant growth-promoting substances including auxins, gibberellins, and vitamins that stimulate root development and shoot vigor.

product_overview: IGreen P is a single-nutrient biofertilizer based on the beneficial bacterium Bacillus megaterium, formulated for targeted phosphorus management. It solubilizes bound and insoluble soil phosphorus, releasing it into forms the plant can absorb — improving root development and fruit/grain formation. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) systems.
key_product_highlights: Delivers targeted phosphorus nutrition through biological phosphorus solubilization
Improves nutrient uptake efficiency and crop response
Reduces dependence on synthetic fertilizers
Enhances root development and rhizosphere activity
Compatible with organic farming and INM programs
Improves crop yield and produce quality

mechanism_of_action.description: Bacillus megaterium secretes organic acids and phosphatase enzymes in the rhizosphere that solubilize fixed inorganic phosphates and mineralize organic phosphorus compounds. This releases plant-available orthophosphate ions, enhancing P uptake efficiency and reducing dependence on chemical phosphate fertilizers.

product_overview: IGreen K is a single-nutrient biofertilizer based on the beneficial bacterium Frateuria aurantia, formulated for targeted potassium management. It mobilizes bound soil potassium from silicate minerals and clay, improving plant K uptake for stronger stalks, better yield, and enhanced quality parameters. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) systems.
key_product_highlights: Delivers targeted potassium nutrition through biological potassium mobilization
Improves nutrient uptake efficiency and crop response
Reduces dependence on synthetic fertilizers
Enhances root development and rhizosphere activity
Compatible with organic farming and INM programs
Improves crop yield and produce quality

mechanism_of_action.description: Frateuria aurantia produces organic acids and exopolysaccharides that weather potassium-bearing silicate minerals and release K+ ions from clay lattices into the soil solution. This mobilized potassium becomes readily available for root uptake, improving crop tolerance to drought and disease.

product_overview: IGreen S is a single-nutrient biofertilizer based on the beneficial bacterium Thiobacillus thiooxidans, formulated for targeted sulfur management. It oxidizes elemental and reduced sulfur compounds into plant-available sulfate, essential for protein synthesis, oil formation in oilseeds, and pungency in bulb crops. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) systems.
key_product_highlights: Delivers targeted sulfur nutrition through biological sulfur oxidation
Improves nutrient uptake efficiency and crop response
Reduces dependence on synthetic fertilizers
Enhances root development and rhizosphere activity
Compatible with organic farming and INM programs
Improves crop yield and produce quality

mechanism_of_action.description: Thiobacillus thiooxidans is a chemoautotrophic bacterium that oxidizes elemental sulfur (S0) and reduced sulfur compounds into sulfate (SO4 2-) — the primary plant-available form of sulfur. It also lowers soil pH locally, improving micronutrient availability in alkaline soils.

product_overview: IGreen Si is a single-nutrient biofertilizer based on the beneficial bacterium Bacillus mucilaginosus, formulated for targeted silicon management. It solubilizes silicate minerals and releases bio-available silicon, strengthening cell walls and improving plant tolerance to pests, diseases, and abiotic stresses. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) systems.
key_product_highlights: Delivers targeted silicon nutrition through biological silicon solubilization
Improves nutrient uptake efficiency and crop response

mechanism_of_action.description: Bacillus mucilaginosus produces organic acids and polysaccharides that dissolve silicate minerals, releasing plant-available silicic acid. Absorbed silicon deposits in cell walls to reinforce structural integrity, reducing insect penetration, fungal infection, and lodging in cereals.

product_overview: IGreen Zn is a single-nutrient biofertilizer based on the beneficial bacterium Bacillus aryabhattai, formulated for targeted zinc management. It solubilizes fixed and insoluble zinc compounds in soil, releasing plant-available Zn ions that support enzyme function, chlorophyll formation, and grain filling. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) systems.
key_product_highlights: Delivers targeted zinc nutrition through biological zinc solubilization
Improves nutrient uptake efficiency and crop response
Reduces dependence on synthetic fertilizers
Enhances root development and rhizosphere activity
Compatible with organic farming and INM programs
Improves crop yield and produce quality

mechanism_of_action.description: Bacillus aryabhattai secretes organic acids (gluconic and 2-keto-gluconic acid) that chelate and solubilize insoluble zinc compounds such as ZnO, ZnCO3, and Zn3(PO4)2. The released Zn2+ ions become available for root uptake, correcting the widespread zinc deficiency that limits yield across staple crops.
